payload.claim: budget_usd (30), max_attempts (3) and max_turns (170) look tight next to this spec's own closest precedents. SA-0325, which built only the send_back closure (a strict subset of this spec's criteria 4-5), spent $18.23 in one attempt that still ended EXHAUSTED. SA-0326, a comparably-shaped addition (one new ~344-line module plus wiring), was given budget_usd 48 and max_turns 240. SA-0327 asks for a brand-new judge_draft function with worktree/ref/symlink handling, ran_dir wiring, a reshaped _finish_verify, send-back integration spanning finish.py, follow_up.py and cli.py, five docstring rewrites, and large new witness tests across three test files -- a broader surface than either precedent -- yet gets a smaller budget and turn ceiling than SA-0326.
